verdict.rationale: dlt supports local DuckDB destinations and easily configurable destinations, which lets an AI-native user run pipelines locally/in a sandbox without touching production data (dlt-gh-1, dlt-docs-7, dlt-docs-29, dlt-docs-21), and the AI Harness/Playground workspace explicitly gives coding agents a sandbox to build pipelines (dlt-docs-44). However, there is no explicit 'sandbox environment' feature, no documented isolation/test-mode guarantees, or dedicated staging/sandbox destination separate from production config. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/test-mode documentation, isolation guarantees preventing accidental production writes, independent validation of safe agent sandbox usage.
